title: Austin Housing Finance: $23M Bonds & Aid
summary:
*   **Boost for Affordable Homeownership:** Approved establishing a Mortgage Credit Certificate Program, designed to help more residents afford homes.
*   **Securing $23 Million in Housing Funds:** Authorized an application for $23,000,000 in bond authority to finance critical affordable housing initiatives.
*   **Leadership Appointment:** Mayor Pro Tem Gus Garcia was appointed as the new Vice President of the Housing Finance Corporation.
